title: track: file imap-types upstream issue for StatusDataItemName::Size
description:
File a GitHub issue against duesee/imap-codec requesting StatusDataItemName::Size and StatusDataItem::Size(u64) variants, following the pattern of StatusDataItemName::Deleted and StatusDataItem::DeletedStorage which were added as a feature-gated extension.

The issue should note: (1) RFC 8438 STATUS=SIZE and RFC 9051 baseline require this, (2) StatusDataItemName has no Other escape hatch so the extension cannot be implemented without a library change, (3) suggest feature flag ext_status_size following the project's existing pattern.

Also create a separate Beads issue under this epic tracking the deferred STATUS=SIZE implementation, blocked on the upstream library adding the variant.

Acceptance: GitHub issue filed at duesee/imap-codec with clear problem statement and suggested API; Beads tracking issue created.
